title: Why rereading your notes isn't revision

sources.title: Metacognitive strategies in student learning: Do students practise retrieval when they study on their own? (Memory 17(4), 471–479)
sources.claim: On an open-ended survey, college students most frequently reported rereading notes or textbook; self-testing ranked low.

sources.title: Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques – press summary
sources.claim: Rereading received a low utility rating; practice testing and distributed practice received high utility.

sources.title: Test-Enhanced Learning – APS Observer summary
sources.claim: Repeated studying increased students' confidence, but prior testing produced substantially greater retention on 2-day and 1-week delayed tests.

sources.title: Plasmo – past papers, marked by AI
sources.claim: Real past papers answered online and marked straight away, with written feedback on every answer.
